page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout (e.g. "suis", "salutem", "effusi"). "sectădum" (Isa. 5) read with a tilde over the a: [?] not added, as the tilde is faint. "mastat" (Isa. 66) is read as printed "stat" after a line-break "ma-"; the word is doubtful, so the reading is marked [?]. "fal[?]" (Ier. 14) is cut off at the page edge, so the word is incomplete. "40.17 [?]": the printed symbol after the page number is doubtful. The line "mihi aquarum" (Hos. 2) is set across a line break in the scan; the reading is inferred from the broken word and should be checked. The page ends mid-entry ("qui"), so the entry continues on the next page.
